2026-08-18.summary:
### NPC & Scientist Fixes
- Fixed AI navigation with independent navmeshes and prevented AIs spawned before a navmesh was built from getting lost.  
- NPCs no longer get stuck when a navmesh tile rebuilds while they are inside or crossing it.  
- Cargo ship scientists now move correctly; Oil Rig Scientist 2 crouch‑walk angle fixed; old scientists now turn instantly instead of steering.  
- Scientists now spawn reliably in Underwater Labs, Cargo Ships, and Military Bases.  

### Vehicles & Weapons
- Catapult ammo pooling bug fixed and siege weapons now reset properly after use.  
- Helicopter rotor speed resets on init; vehicle pooling improvements merged.  
- Salvaged hammer and flamethrower 3rd‑person models now align correctly with the player’s hand.  
- Honey bandage now applies its healing effects; binocular glare bug fixed.  

### UI & Leaderboards
- Darts leaderboard UI fixed, works after server restarts and now supports streamer mode.  
- Colour picker accepts pasted hex codes and no longer shares colour data between painting menus.  
- Tutorial modal size fixed and fully localized.  

### Animals & World
- New cow and sheep livestock prefabs added (male/female); livestock no longer move while sleeping and now drop dung.  
- Monument toggle switches work; monument blockers added with balanced resource rates and time‑to‑kill values.  
- Gas station roof chairs are now mountable; wind turbine sound stops when the turbine isn’t spinning.
2026-08-18.new_summary:
- Fixed a crash that could occur on game launch due to the hide‑services change.  
- Added Apple tree content; apples now spawn, though they currently cannot be harvested.  
- Livestock animals now drop horse dung.

2026-08-17.summary:
### Animals
- Fixed the gender bug: livestock now spawn with the correct male/female distribution instead of all being female.  
- Added a breeding state machine, enabling animals to breed as intended.  
- Introduced a Bull prefab, so bulls now appear in the world.

### Server & UI
- Nexus connect modal now correctly enables the map button and no longer squishes the map view.  
- Nexus map UI issues resolved, preventing the map from being distorted after recent changes.  
- Server listings now hide zone servers by default and expose Nexus info in A2S rules responses.  
- MaxPlayers count displayed correctly after recent adjustments.  
- General Nexus connect modal fixes improve stability when joining servers.

### Items & Equipment
- Medical honey bandage effects now fire properly, restoring the intended healing behavior.  
- Water bucket UI bug fixed: players can now transfer water into a held bucket without errors.

### Vehicles
- Resolved a pooling issue where runtime‑parented vehicle children caused null‑reference errors, improving vehicle spawn stability.
